semanticChecks.clothingAndAgency: Activity, preference and comfort retained; permission to remove a jacket is distinct from actual removal/change and planned own button fastening. Appropriate hemiplegia examples dress affected side first/undress unaffected first, without pulling joints, under-body fabric or affected-arm entrapment. Rinsing/spitting/swallowing ability and individual water/posture plan stay explicit; no forced mouth opening or copious water with unknown ability. Remaining teeth/mouth care is not replaced by denture removal.
semanticChecks.dentures: Full versus partial denture retention/removal and dental instructions remain distinct; identity cannot be inferred from case color, lid proximity, size or trying in the mouth. No boiling, forceful insertion, bending, pulling clasps or biting incompletely seated dentures into place.
semanticChecks.skinAndBathing: Epidermis/dermis/subcutaneous fat and eccrine/apocrine/sebaceous roles retained. Sudden-temperature-change heat shock is distinct from heat illness. Benefits are conditional; room/water/tub/floor/curtain checks, health/consent, meal timing, hydration and required supervision are not waived. Bath entry/support/exit and post-bath checks follow individual plan/training.
semanticChecks.grooming: Face/eye inner-to-outer cleansing, clean surface for other eye, appropriate product/skin review, nail abnormalities and medical reporting retained. Shaving consent does not authorize new cosmetics or blades; new pain/abrasion/bleeding triggers stopping/reporting and method review. Makeup removal before sleep retained.
semanticChecks.partialBathAndWiping: Hand/foot bathing does not replace every whole-bath function or authorize abnormal nail cutting. Posture/support/container/temperature and diminished sensation checks remain. Wiping consent is body-part-specific; clean/rinse off soap/dry/recover one part at a time. Actual towel temperature at contact is distinguished from preparation temperature. No forceful leg or shoulder pulling.
